# clavis syncs create

<p class="cli-lead">Create a sync to GitHub, GitLab, Vercel, AWS, an HTTP endpoint, and more</p>

<div class="cli-usage">

```sh
clavis syncs create ENVIRONMENT [flags]
```

</div>

Create a sync for an environment. `--provider` picks the target; the matching flags configure it.

## Examples

<p class="cli-example-title">GitHub Actions secrets (token)</p>

```sh
clavis syncs create prod --provider github --github-repo acme/web \
  --github-token "$GITHUB_TOKEN"
```

<p class="cli-example-title">GitHub environment (GitHub App)</p>

```sh
clavis syncs create prod --provider github --github-scope environment \
  --github-repo acme/web --github-environment production \
  --github-app-id 42 --github-installation-id 123 \
  --github-private-key @app.private-key.pem
```

<p class="cli-example-title">GitLab CI/CD variables</p>

```sh
clavis syncs create dev --provider gitlab --gitlab-project group/project \
  --gitlab-token "$GITLAB_TOKEN" --masked
```

<p class="cli-example-title">Vercel</p>

```sh
clavis syncs create prod --provider vercel --vercel-project prj_123 \
  --vercel-token "$VERCEL_TOKEN"
```

<p class="cli-example-title">Netlify</p>

```sh
clavis syncs create dev --provider netlify --netlify-account acme \
  --netlify-token "$NETLIFY_TOKEN"
```

<p class="cli-example-title">Cloudflare Workers</p>

```sh
clavis syncs create dev --provider cloudflare --cloudflare-account "$CF_ACCOUNT" \
  --cloudflare-mode workers --cloudflare-script my-worker --cloudflare-token "$CF_TOKEN"
```

<p class="cli-example-title">Forgejo, Gitea or Codeberg</p>

```sh
clavis syncs create dev --provider forgejo --forgejo-url https://git.example.com \
  --forgejo-repo team/web --forgejo-token "$FORGEJO_TOKEN"
```

<p class="cli-example-title">AWS SSM Parameter Store</p>

```sh
clavis syncs create prod --provider aws --aws-region eu-central-1 \
  --aws-access-key "$AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID" --aws-secret-key "$AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY" \
  --aws-service ssm
```

<p class="cli-example-title">Google Secret Manager</p>

```sh
clavis syncs create prod --provider gcp --gcp-project my-project \
  --gcp-service-account-json @service-account.json
```

<p class="cli-example-title">Any HTTP endpoint (signed JSON POST)</p>

```sh
clavis syncs create dev --endpoint https://deploy.example.com/hooks/clavis --secret "$SYNC_SECRET"
```

## Details

Forgejo secrets are write-only, so drift checks compare variables and only confirm that secrets exist.
